title: DomainDeclaration
description: The domain-signed declaration a company publishes at https://<domain>/.well-known/trooth.json (docs/DECLARATION.md): its own Ed25519 key, its products, its APIs and its code repositories, signed with that key over the RFC 8785 bytes of the document without `signature`. At most 64 KB. It is self-signed: a declaration that checks shows that whoever controlled the site's content when it was read published this key and these subjects; it does not establish the legal entity or a person's authority to act for it. Added in trooth 0.14.0.

domain.description: The domain, lower case. It must equal the host the document is served from.

issued_at.description: When the declaration was signed, ISO 8601 in UTC. Not in the future.

expires_at.description: When the declaration stops checking, ISO 8601 in UTC; after issued_at and at most 400 days after it.

record.description: Optional: the company's Trooth record, https://trooth.co/network/company/<slug>. The one URL not on the domain.

keys.description: The company's own public keys, one to eight; more than one during a key rotation. Never a private key.

products.description: Products the domain's owner names. Each url is on the domain or a subdomain of it.

apis.description: APIs the domain's owner names, each with an optional MCP server and the SHA-256 of its tool manifest.

repositories.description: Organizations or users on a code host (github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org, codeberg.org) the domain's owner names.

signature.description: Ed25519 over the RFC 8785 bytes of the document without this member, by one of `keys`.

DeclarationKey.title: DeclarationKey
DeclarationKey.description: An Ed25519 public key as a JWK (RFC 8037) with its id.

kid.description: <domain>#<the RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint of the key, base64url>.

x.description: The 32-byte public key, base64url without padding.

DeclaredProduct.title: DeclaredProduct
DeclaredProduct.description: A product the domain's owner names. Its subject id is trooth:product:<domain>/<id>.

id.description: The product's id, unique in the declaration.

url.description: An https URL on the domain or a subdomain of it.

DeclaredMcp.title: DeclaredMcp
DeclaredMcp.description: The MCP server of an API.

url.description: The MCP endpoint, an https URL on the domain or a subdomain of it.

manifest_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the server's tool manifest (docs/EVIDENCE.md section 9).

DeclaredApi.title: DeclaredApi
DeclaredApi.description: An API the domain's owner names.

base_url.description: The API's base URL, https, on the domain or a subdomain of it.

kid.description: The kid of the key in `keys` that signed.

canonicalization.description: The canonicalization of the signed bytes.

value.description: ed25519: and the 64-byte signature in base64.
